starting_point.explanation: A typical bill at this stage with 71 days left, before looking at its other signals.

factors.factor: Sponsor's party controls the chamber where it started
Sponsor's party controls the other chamber
Has a matching bill in the other chamber

research_adjustments.reason: Industry (ULSE explicitly urging Senate passage; PeopleForBikes supporting a mandatory standard), consumer groups (Consumer Reports) and fire-service organizations (IAFC, NVFC lobbying) all back the same core requirement, and delivery platforms lobby for the bill. The support is for the UL-standard mandate rather than every bill provision.

notes: Only 71 days are left in this Congress. If it doesn't pass both chambers by then, the bill dies and must be reintroduced.

model_info.method: Logistic regression per stage, trained on every House and Senate bill in those Congresses.
